Blast radius of Lambda execution roles. Traces from each Lambda function through its execution role's IAM permission graph — including transitive role assumption, service-coupled escalation, and cross-account reach — to enumerate all resources a compromised Lambda can access. Compounds per-resource Lambda and IAM controls with graph-level blast radius analysis via Soufflé/Datalog.
